ms.report:
Proof of Achievement: Milestone 3
The HashiRWA platform has been deployed and is accessible through its own dedicated web domain hashirwa.trade. This milestone delivers a functional marketplace interface together with issuer and investor workflows that illustrate how real-world asset listings can be presented with verification signals, supporting documentation, and external reference data. The next (final) milestone will integrate the oracle from the previous milestone and brings together issuer and investor.

Evidence of Milestone Completion
The platform is publicly accessible at:
 https://app.hashirwa.trade/landing

Video walkthrough:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1d8orQQZZkjqGGIiqJ3gn3JAofwciUojv/view?usp=sharing

You can follow the demonstrated pages via web navigation or here:
Landing page:
 https://app.hashirwa.trade/landing
Issuer workflow:
 https://app.hashirwa.trade/issuer
Investor dashboard:
 https://app.hashirwa.trade/investor
Marketplace view:
 https://app.hashirwa.trade/marketplace

Platform Interface Screenshots
The repository includes screenshots demonstrating the operational platform components
https://github.com/Sapient-Predictive-Analytics/hashirwa/tree/main/mockups/marketplaceMVP
• Marketplace interface displaying verified listings
 • Dashboard with watchlist functionality and reference market data signals
 • Notification feed demonstrating system activity events
 • Document vault interface supporting due diligence references

The entire main branch of the project including app code and oracle integration can be seen in its permanent Github repo:
https://github.com/Sapient-Predictive-Analytics/hashirwa
